import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')
# Ensure the data is sorted by 'Tax Year'
df = df.sort_values(by='Tax Year')

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(df['Tax Year'], df['Tax Rate %'], marker='o', markersize=5, linewidth=2)
plt.title('Trend of Tax Rate % Over Tax Years')
plt.xlabel('Tax Year')
plt.ylabel('Tax Rate %')
plt.xticks(ticks=range(int(df['Tax Year'].min()), int(df['Tax Year'].max())+1, 2))  # Set x-ticks for better readability
plt.grid(True)
#Chart INFO: {'x_fields': 'Tax Year', 'y_fields': ['Tax Rate %'], 'chart_type': 'lineChart'}
plt.show()
